citations.quote: Picato® gel is indicated for the topical treatment of actinic keratosis.

This new drug application provides for the use of Picato® (ingenol mebutate) Gel, 0.015% for actinic keratoses on the face and scalp, and Picato® (ingenol mebutate) Gel, 0.05% for actinic keratoses on the trunk and extremities.

target_moa.text: Ingenol mebutate induces cell death when applied topically to actinic keratoses via a dual mechanism of local lesional cell death and promotion of an inflammatory response (neutrophil infiltration); the precise mechanism is unknown

citations.quote: Ingenol mebutate is a new molecular entity that induces cell death when applied topically to actinic keratoses.

In vivo and in vitro models have supported a dual mechanism of action for the effects of ingenol mebutate: 1) induction of local lesional cell death and 2) promoting an inflammatory response characterized as infiltration of neutrophils and other immunocompetent cells.
The mechanism of action by which Picato® gel induces cell death in treating AK lesions is unknown.

Eye/ocular disorders and severe local skin reactions can occur.
